original.target_description: APOE ε4 carrier versus noncarrier difference in standardized global cognitive index in nondemented older adults; Table 1 Standardized Cognitive Score row, contextualized by the replication cognitive main-effect test on p. 7.

n.sample_role: Participants: ε4 noncarriers; ε4 carriers, respectively, as printed in Table 1 column headers.
n.exclusions: CDR 0; neurological disease other than AD, ischemic heart disease, significant mental illness, diabetes, or other systemic illness impairing study completion excluded. Genotype and brain imaging availability required. No test-specific missingness reported.

p.location: Table 1, Standardized Cognitive Score row; Results, Demographics statistical analysis

replication.target_description: Main effect of APOE group on memory and executive-function composite scores: between-subjects MANCOVA across ε2+, ε3ε3 and ε4+ groups, covarying age, sex and education; p. 7. This is a conceptual cognitive replication with changed measures and an added genotype group.

n.sample_role: Participants in the cognitive MANCOVA; exact analytic count cannot be established from the reported generic final sample.
n.exclusions: Final overall sample reported as 116 after image/genotype screening; additional 9 controls excluded from VBM only. Cognitive MANCOVA-specific complete-case count is not stated.
n.quote: The final sample size after applying exclusion criteria was 116.

es.location: p. 7, MANCOVA and cognitive-structural neural correlates

p.location: p. 7, MANCOVA and cognitive-structural neural correlates

reported_success.quote: The current study did not replicate these findings, although the measures used to evaluate memory and EF in the current study varied slightly, which may explain the discrepant findings.

notes: The cognitive test is identified by pairing original Table 1 with the principal cognitive main-effect statistic on replication p. 7. Original Table 1 prints group means and SDs, but no standardized effect size or test statistic for this contrast; these were not converted. Replication domain-specific partial eta squared values were not paired with the omnibus p. Analytic replication n was not inferred from degrees of freedom or equated to the generic final sample. Measures differ: original global index versus joint memory/EF composites; replication includes ε2+ as an additional group.
